neighbours.label: the main verb of a funding or resource-use statement in active voice (grants supported this study; no public funds were used for it), as against the same facts phrased passively or other main verbs
fire: Funding from the Wellcome Trust supported this study of malaria in children.
No state funds were used to pay for the governor's holiday flights.
A grant from the Gates Foundation supported the field trials in Kenya.
No school district money was used for the coach's private dinner.
Donations from local families supported the new library wing.
No federal dollars were used to build the private stadium.
An award from the European Research Council supported the early experiments.
No club funds were used for the president's family vacation.
quiet: This study of malaria in children was funded by the Wellcome Trust.
The governor paid for the holiday flights out of his own salary.
The field trials in Kenya were backed by a grant from the Gates Foundation.
The coach paid for the private dinner with his own credit card.
The new library wing opened to the public in early spring.
The private stadium was built on land next to the river.
The early experiments took place in a small basement lab.
The club president took his family to the coast for a week.

predictions: fire 0.15-0.4 on 'supported'/'used' in funding statements; passive 'was supported by' and unrelated verbs below 0.1
